9DK6: O Dear One, I am not high or low or in the middle. I am the Lord's slave, and I seek the Lord's Sanctuary.
O Sire, I am not high neither low nor middling. I am God's slave and I seek His protection.
SLC9: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am detached from the world; I have forgotten sorrow, separation and disease. ||1||
I am imbued with only the Name am detached from the world and have forgotten sorrow, separation and ailment.
G0S1: O Siblings of Destiny, by Guru's Grace, I perform devotional worship to my Lord and Master.
O brother, by the grace of the Guru Lord's devotional; service is performed.

52L0: Vak = through the word, through the Shabad. Kan = dependence. Jam ki baki = such an outstanding account that Jamraj's power could fall on one.
One whose heart is filled with the Hymns of the True Guru, obtains the Pure Lord. He is not under the power of the Messenger of Death, nor does he owe Death anything. ||1||Pause||
He, within whose mind are the hymns of the True Guru obtains the pure Lord. He is neither under the rule of death nor he owes death anything. Pause.
through the word, through the Shabad
such an outstanding account that Jamraj's power could fall on one
ETX2: Rasan = tongue. Ravahi = they chant. Prabh sange = in the company of the Lord. Sahaj = spontaneously.
He chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord with his tongue, and abides with God; he does whatever pleases the Lord.
He utters God's praise with his tongue, feels Lord's presence and does whatever pleases Him the Lord God.
in the company of the Lord
10ZA: Jag = in the world. Mek = even one.
Without the Lord's Name, life passes in vain in the world, and every moment is useless. ||2||
Without God's name gain is man's life in this world and every moment which passes without God goes fruitless.
31CX: Ghar = in the house. Gati = high spiritual state.
The false have no place of rest, either inside or outside; the slanderer does not find salvation.
O Sire, within and without there is no room for the false one and the slanderer finds no salvation.
7WVS: Ros = anger. Bakhas = forgiveness. Savai = ever more.
Even if one is resentful, God does not withhold His blessings; day by day, they increase. ||3||
Though the man reproves and resents the Lord discontinues not His gifts, which grow more day by day.
ZHEC: No one can take away the Guru's gifts; my Lord and Master Himself has given them.
The Guru's gift none can erase O Sire for my Lord has Himself caused it to be given.
PKBZ: Kale mukh = black-faced. Na bhai = did not seem good.
The black-faced slanderers, with slander in their mouths, do not appreciate the Guru's gifts. ||4||
The black slanderers, who like not Guru's Gift, have slander in their mouth.
L33D: Bakhsi = having forgiven, having shown mercy. Bilam = delay. Adhua rai = half a mustard seed, even a little.
God forgives and blends with Himself those who take to His Sanctuary; He does not delay for an instant.
O Sire, the Lord pardons and blends with Himself those who enter His sanctuary and in this He makes not even half an iota's delay.
half a mustard seed, even a little
P8YJ: Anad mul = the source of joys. Siri natha = at the head of the Naths. Mel = into union.
He is the source of bliss, the Greatest Lord; through the True Guru, we are united in His Union. ||5||
The source of bliss is He the Lord of Lord's and the True Guru, unites in His union.
at the head of the Naths
E4ER: Ravia = remembered. Bhraman = wandering. Chukai = ended.
Through His Kindness, the Kind Lord pervades us; through Guru's Teachings, our wanderings cease.
O Sire, the ever gracious Lord is meditated upon by Guru's grace and through Guru's instruction do our wanderings cease.
TJZ9: Bhet = by touching, by meeting. Vadiai = greatness, blessing.
Touching the philosopher's stone, metal is transformed into gold. Such is the glorious greatness of the Society of the Saints. ||6||
Touching the philosopher's stone metal becomes gold. Such is the greatness of the society of saints.
53SH: Majan = dip, bath. Bhai = was pleasing.
The Lord is the immaculate water; the mind is the bather, and the True Guru is the bath attendant, O Siblings of Destiny.
God's name, is the pure water the soul is the bather and the True Guru is the bath-man, O brother.
WF1C: That humble being who joins the Sat Sangat shall not be consigned to reincarnation again; his light merges into the Light. ||7||
By associating with the saints society man is not born again and his light merges into the Supreme light.
ZTYN: You are the Great Primal Lord, the infinite tree of life; I am a bird perched on Your branches.
You are the Great Lord and an Infinite Tree and I a bird am under Yours protection.
WPL6: Jugi jugi = always. Salahi = may I praise.
Grant to Nanak the Immaculate Naam; throughout the ages, he sings the Praises of the Shabad. ||8||4||
Grant to Nanak Your Immaculate Name and he will sing Name's praise all the ages through.
Q5N6: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By True Guru's grace, He is attained.
8ZDL: Aradhitan = (those who) have worshipped. Sach = the eternal God. Pias = longing. Param = highest. Hitan = love. Bhai hitan = in loving devotion.
The devotees worship the Lord in loving adoration. They thirst for the True Lord, with infinite affection.
The saints remember God with love. They thirst for the True Name and hear it with infinite affection.
6ZPZ: They tearfully beg and implore the Lord; in love and affection, their consciousness is at peace. ||1||
They beseech and implore the Lord with tears and through hearty love and affection abide in peace.
GMGE: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and take to His Sanctuary.
My soul, utter you the Name and seek Lord's protection.
HGAB: Tari = boat, ship. Ram nam = the Name of Ram. Karani = deed, the aim of life.
The Lord's Name is the boat to cross over the world-ocean. Practice such a way of life. ||1||Pause||
Lord's Name is the boat to cross the world-ocean. Adopt you such a way of life. Pause.
Q9LF: E = O! Mirat = death, detachment from vices. Subh chintan = well-wishing, bringing comfort. Ramanan = remembrance.
O mind, even death wishes you well, when you remember the Lord through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
By remembering God under Guru's instruction, even death becomes your well-wisher, O man.
SG6G: Tat = the root of the world, God. Gianan = acquaintance, deep familiarity. Kalian = comfort, bliss.
The intellect receives the treasure, the knowledge of reality and supreme bliss, by repeating the Lord's Name in the mind. ||2||
By heartily repeating God's Name, man's mind receives the treasure of real Divine knowledge and supreme bliss.
4SSA: Chal chit = that which unsettles the mind. Vit = wealth. Bhramabhraman = wandering. Magan = intoxicated.
The fickle consciousness wanders around chasing after wealth; it is intoxicated with worldly love and emotional attachment.
The mercurial (restless) mind wanders and runs after wealth and is intoxicated with the love of temporal attachment.
G42S: Gur vak = through the Guru's Shabad. Dirhan = (has) made firm. Mati = intellect, understanding.
Devotion to the Naam is permanently implanted within the mind, when it is attuned to the Guru's Teachings and His Shabad. ||3||
Being imbued with Guru's hymns and instruction, God Name and devotional service are permanently established in man's mind.
T2GR: Bharmat = wanders. Bharam = wandering. Janam = in birth (and death). Biadh = disease. Khapan = is ruined.
Wandering around, doubt is not dispelled; afflicted by reincarnation, the world is being ruined.
By wandering to holy places doubt departs not with the curse of birth and death the world is ruined.
64GN: Nihkevalan = free of desire. Sat = eternal.
The Lord's eternal throne is free of this affliction; he is truly wise, who takes the Naam as his deep meditation. ||4||
God's seat is free from this curse and he who is truly wise utters the Name as his penance.
H916: Biapitan = overpowered, pressed down. Adhik = much.
This world is engrossed in attachment and transitory love; it suffers the terrible pains of birth and death.
This world is engrossed in temporal love and attachment and endures the great pain of birth and death.
PX98: Run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, chant the Lord's Name in your heart, and you shall swim across. ||5||
By hastening to the True Guru's asylum and repeating God's Name heartily the mortal swims across.
HVF0: Nihchal = unshakable. Mani = in the mind (hold it). Manan = will agree, will become accustomed. Sahaj = poised spiritual state.
Following the Guru's Teaching, the mind becomes stable; the mind accepts it, and reflects upon it in peaceful poise.
By accepting Lord's meditation, under Guru's teaching, stable becomes the man's mind.
XNZ8: That mind is pure, which enshrines Truth within, and the most excellent jewel of spiritual wisdom. ||6||
Pure is the mind in which there is truth and the excellent jewel of Divine knowledge.
J4BB: Bhai = in the fear (of God). Bhai = in the love (of God). Tar = cross over. Bhavjal = world-ocean. Lai = attach.
By the Fear of God, and Love of God, and by devotion, man crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, focusing his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.
By fear, love worship and fixing his attention on God's Feet, the man crosses the terrible ocean.

G48T: The Name of the Lord, the most pure and sacred, is within my heart; this body is Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||7||
O God, enshrine within my mind Your Name which is the purest of the pure. This body of mine is in Your sanctuary.
VGFN: Nivaranan = able to remove. Rasi = capital, wealth. Manan = in the mind.
The waves of greed and avarice are subdued, by treasuring the Lord's Name in the mind.
The capital of God's Name in the mind undoes the waves of avarice and greed.
YE3S: Niranjana = O Niranjan! O Lord free of Maya!
Subdue my mind, O Pure Immaculate Lord; says Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||8||1||5||
Chasten my mind, You O pure Lord. Says Nanak, I have entered Your asylum.
L0RG: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
L3MJ: Nirat = dance. Kari = I do. Nachai = I make dance.
I dance, and make this mind dance as well.
I dance and make this mind of mine to dance also.
TGPB: Parsadi = by grace. Ap = the sense of self. Gavai = I lose.
By Guru's Grace, I eliminate my self-conceit.
By Guru's grace, I efface my self-conceit.
Y1EV: Thir = steady. Rakhai = keeps. Mukat = liberation (from the bonds of Maya). Ichhi = I wish. Pai = I obtain.
One who keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord is liberated; he obtains the fruits of his desires. ||1||
He, who keeps his mind fixed on God, is emancipated and obtains the fruit which he yearns for.
6NJG: Gur kai agai = in front of the Guru, staying face to face with the Guru.
So dance, O mind, before your Guru.
Dance, O man, before your Guru.
in front of the Guru, staying face to face with the Guru
Y8DV: Bhanai nachahi = if you dance in His Will, if you walk in the Hukam, dancing as He makes you dance. Ante = at the end. Jam bhau = fear of death.
If you dance according to the Guru's Will, you shall obtain peace, and in the end, the fear of death shall leave you. ||Pause||
If you dancest according to the Guru's will then you shall obtain peace and at the last moment the fear of death shall leave you. Pause
if you dance in His Will, if you walk in the Hukam, dancing as He makes you dance
R7DV: Nachai = makes dance, makes walk in His will, moves at His signals. Kahiai = is called.
One whom the Lord Himself causes to dance, is called a devotee. He Himself links us to His Love.
He, whom the Lord Himself causes to dance is called a saint. To His love He Himself applies the man.
makes dance, makes walk in His will, moves at His signals
FDC5: Apae = by Himself. Margi = on the (right) path.
He Himself sings, He Himself listens, and He puts this blind mind on the right path. ||2||
God Himself sings, Himself causes to hear and puts this blind man on the right path.
V3TS: Anadin = every day, at every moment. Nachai = dances, dances to God's signals, walks in God's will. Sakti = Maya (its influence). Nivarai = removes. Siv = God, the embodiment of bliss. Siv ghar = at the feet of God. Nid = the sleep of heedlessness.
One who dances night and day, and banishes Shakti's Maya, enters the House of the Lord Shiva, where there is no sleep.
He who dances night and day and banishes mammon, enters the Master's mansion, where there is no sleep.
FXM6: Avaro = only the song of Maya. Manmukhi = a person who follows their own mind. Surinar = a godlike person, a person of godly nature.
The world is asleep in Maya, the house of Shakti; it dances, jumps and sings in duality. The self-willed manmukh has no devotion. ||3||
Asleep in the house of mammon the world dances leaps and sings of duality. The perverse person embraces not meditation.
MF95: Virat = engagement in worldly life. Virat pakh = on the side of worldly engagement, even while doing worldly work. Karmi = by (God's) grace. Nache = have been dancing at God's signals, walking in His will. Munijan = sages, silent ones. Bichari = thoughtful.
The angels, mortals, renunciates, ritualists, silent sages and beings of spiritual wisdom dance.
The demigods, men renouncers, rutualists, silent sages and the divines dance.
37BJ: Gurmukhi = by taking the Guru's shelter. Traigun = the three qualities of Maya.
The Siddhas and seekers, lovingly focused on the Lord, dance, as do the Gurmukhs, whose minds dwell in reflective meditation. ||4||
The perfect persons, strivers and pious persons who have discernible intellect embrace Lord's love and dance.
3PQ1: Nache = have been dancing at God's signals, walking in His will. Liv = yearning.
The planets and solar systems dance in the three qualities, as do those who bear love for You, Lord.
The universes solar systems beings endowed with three dispositions and morals who bear You love, O Lord dance.
DKYT: Khani chari = beings of the four sources of life (egg-born, womb-born, sweat-born, earth-born).
The beings and creatures all dance, and the four sources of creation dance. ||5||
The men and beasts and birds all dance as also dance the four sources of creation.
beings of the four sources of life (egg-born, womb-born, sweat-born, earth-born)
WM6M: Tudh bhavahi = are pleasing to You. Sei = those very people. Sabadi = through the Shabad.
They alone dance, who are pleasing to You, and who, as Gurmukhs, embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.
They alone dance, who are pleasing to You and who the pious bear love to the Name.
07ST: Tat = the root of the world, God. Giani = those who have deep familiarity. Kau = to.
They are devotees, with the essence of spiritual wisdom, who obey the Hukam of His Command. ||6||
They are the saints and they the real divines whom You causes to obey Your command.
1US9: Sache siu = with the eternal God. Liv = yearning.
This is devotional worship, that one loves the True Lord; without service, one cannot be a devotee.
This is the worship that one loves the True One. Without service one cannot be a saint.
4A81: Jivat marai = dies while living; while doing worldly work, stays untouched by the love of Maya.
If one remains dead while yet alive, he reflects upon the Shabad, and then, he obtains the True Lord. ||7||
If man remains dead in life, i.e. controls his self then does he reflect on the Name and then alone can he obtain the True Lord.
CGW6: Kai arthi = for the sake of.
So many people dance for the sake of Maya; how rare are those who contemplate reality.
Many men dance for the sake of mammon. Rare is the mortal who meditates on the `Real Thing'.
W1TW: By Guru's Grace, that humble being obtains You, Lord, upon whom You show Mercy. ||8||
The man to whom You showest mercy obtains You, O Lord by Guru's grace.
GG94: If I forget the True Lord, even for an instant, that time passes in vain.
If I forget the True Lord even for an instant that time passes in vain.
8USL: Sahi sahi = with every breath. Rajai = Hukam.
With each and every breath, constantly remember the Lord; He Himself shall forgive you, according to His Will. ||9||
At every breath ever remember you the Lord and He in His will Himself shall forgive You.
9VN4: Gurmukhi = by taking the Guru's shelter. Tudh bhavahi = are pleasing to You. Sei = those very people.
They alone dance, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who, as Gurmukhs, contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
They alone dance who are pleasing to you and also they the Guru-wards, who ponder on the Name.
U9KQ: Says Nanak, they alone find celestial peace, whom You bless with Your Grace. ||10||1||6||
Says Nanak, they on whom is Yours grace obtains the celestial peace.
V3TH: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
MGC0: Jiara = weak life, weak soul. Khir = milk. Adhar = support. Khir adhari = on the support of milk.
Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, like an infant without milk.
Without God, my soul cannot live as a milk-dieted child cannot do without milk.
W5C1: Agam = unreachable. Agochar = beyond the reach of knowledge and the senses. Gurmukhi = by turning to the Guru, by taking the Guru's shelter. Kai = from.
The inaccessible and incomprehensible Lord God is obtained by the Gurmukh; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||
The Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord is obtained through the Guru and to my True Guru, I am a sacrifice.
N4FF: Kirat = praise. Tar tari = make the effort to cross over.
O my mind, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a boat to carry you across.
O my soul, God's praise is a boat to cross over.
make the effort to cross over
TMUK: Amrit jal = water that gives spiritual life.
The Gurmukhs obtain the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You bless them with Your Grace. ||Pause||
They on whom is Yours grace obtain the Name's ambrosial water, through the Guru. Pause.

1UPQ: Sevahi = serve, worship. Anadin = every day. Banvari = the Lord of the world.
Sanak, Sanandan and Naarad the sage serve You; night and day, they continue to chant Your Name, O Lord of the jungle.
Sanak, Sanandan and Narad, the sage, serve You and night and day continue to repeat Your name O Lord of the jungles.
3WXG: Slave Prahlaad sought Your Sanctuary, and You saved his honor. ||2||
Slave Prahlad sought Yours protection and You didst save his honour.
E8TB: Alakh = invisible. Niranjan = free of the dirt of Maya, unattached.
The One unseen immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere, as is the Light of the Lord.
The one Light of the Unseen and pre Lord alone is pervading everywhere.
GUWS: Jachik = beggars. Pasari = spreading out, stretching out.
All are beggars, You alone are the Great Giver. Reaching out our hands, we beg from You. ||3||
All are beggars; You alone are the Giver. Stretching forth their hands all beg You for alms.
TZQJ: Akath = whose true form cannot be described. Niari = unique.
The speech of the humble devotees is sublime; they sing continually the wondrous, Unspoken Speech of the Lord.
Sublime is the speech of the holy-men they ever sing the wondrous and ineffable discourse of God.
whose true form cannot be described
UJXY: Their lives become fruitful; they save themselves, and all their generations. ||4||
Fruitful becomes their life and they save themselves and save their lineage.
9BU7: Manmukh = people who follow their own minds. Dubidha = wavering state. Biape = remain caught. Gubari = darkness.
The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in duality and evil-mindedness; within them is the darkness of attachment.
The way-ward are engrossed in duality and evil-intent and within them is the darkness of worldly love.
people who follow their own minds
UDJV: Na bhavai = does not seem good. Oi = they. San = along with.
They do not love the sermon of the humble Saints, and they are drowned along with their families. ||5||
The gospel of the saintly persons they love not and they get drowned along with their family.
1KVM: Kari = having done. Dhovai = washes. Malbhakh = eater of filth.
By slandering, the slanderer washes the filth off others; he is an eater of filth, and a worshipper of Maya.
By slandering the slanderer washes other's filth and he is the filth eater and wealth - worshipper.
H21K: He indulges in the slander of the humble Saints; he is neither on this shore, nor the shore beyond. ||6||
He indulges in the slander of the pious person. He is neither on this shore nor on the yonder one.
WUTP: Parpanch = the world, the expanse. Kartai = by the Creator. Kal = power, strength.
All this worldly drama is set in motion by the Creator Lord; He has infused His almighty strength into all.
All this world play is set afoot by the Creator and God the Creator has installed might among all.
3H6H: Jug antari = in the world. (Note: the word "jug" here cannot fit any one age such as the Kali Yug.) Khinchai = pulls. Rasani rasani rasi = with love, with love, with love.
The thread of the One Lord runs through the world; when He pulls out this thread, the One Creator alone remains. ||7||
The one Lord's thread worlds in the works in the worlds and when He pulls out the thread the creation falls and only the unique personality remains.
in the world. (Note: the word "jug" here cannot fit any one age such as the Kali Yug.)
KUCR: With their tongues, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and savor Them. They place the sublime essence of the Lord upon their tongues, and savor it.
With their tongue the saints sing God's praise the Nectar of Nectars and on their tongue they place God's elixir.
JFBD: O Nanak, other than the Lord, I ask for nothing else; I am in love with the Love of the Lord's sublime essence. ||8||1||7||
Nanak, without God I ask for nothing but God and the love of Lord's nectar alone is dear to me.
HTAP: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
YV4S: Kahiahi = you are called. Bhuma = lord of the land.
Among kings, You are called the King. Among land-lords, You are the Land-lord.
Among Kings, You are called the King, and among land-lords you are the Land -Lord.
VC9S: Thakur = master, chief. Thakurai = lordship. Koma = (of high) lineage. Siri = on the head, supreme. Koman siri = above those of high lineage.
Among masters, You are the Master. Among tribes, Yours is the Supreme Tribe. ||1||
Among Lords Yours is the over Lordship and among races Yours is the supreme race.
D8X4: My Father is wealthy, deep and profound.
My Father is exceedingly wealthy and unknowable Master.
1NUC: Usatat = praise. Karte = O Creator! Pekhi = seeing. Bisma = amazed. Datan siri = above the givers, supreme among givers.
What praises should I chant, O Creator Lord? Beholding You, I am wonder-struck. ||1||Pause||
What praise of Yours, I Creator, should I narrate? Beholding You, I am astonishingly pleased. Pause.
JX9E: Datan siri = above the givers, supreme among givers.
Among the peaceful, You are called the Peaceful One. Among givers, You are the Greatest Giver.
Among the peaceful, You are called the most peaceful and among the givers the Supreme Giver.
above the givers, supreme among givers
0S28: Tejan mahi = among those of splendour. Rasian mahi = among those who enjoy flavours. Rata = imbued, intoxicated with the flavour.
Among the glorious, You are said to be the Most Glorious. Among revellers, You are the Reveller. ||2||
Of the grandees, You are said to be the great Grandee, and of the relishers the supreme Relisher.
9SSA: Sura = brave warrior. Bhogan mahi = among those who enjoy.
Among warriors, You are called the Warrior. Among indulgers, You are the Indulger.
Among the warriors, You are called she great warrior and among enjoyer the great Enjoyer.
P1R1: Among householders, You are the Great Householder. Among yogis, You are the Yogi. ||3||
Among householders, You are the great. Householder and among Yogis the great Yogi.
9783: Karatan mahi = among those who do new things. Acharan mahi = among those who perform religious rites.
Among creators, You are called the Creator. Among the cultured, You are the Cultured One.
Among builders, You are called the great Maker and among ritualists the great Ritualist.
among those who do new things
among those who perform religious rites
4F11: Among bankers, You are the True Banker. Among merchants, You are the Merchant. ||4||
You are the True Bankers and the supreme Merchant among merchants.
7M4P: Saran palan tika = You are the crest of those who protect the honour of those who take shelter.
Among courts, Yours is the Court. Yours is the Most Sublime of Sanctuaries.
Of all the courts, Yours is the True Court and among the protection givers You are the Supreme.
You are the crest of those who protect the honour of those who take shelter
HV7C: Ketak = how many? countless. Gani na jaiai = cannot be counted. Gan na sakau = I cannot count. Sika = coins, rupees, treasures. Naman mani = among those with fame.
The extent of Your wealth cannot be determined. Your Coins cannot be counted. ||5||
How much is Your wealth, cannot be measured and Yours coins I cannot count.
TGBP: Among names, Your Name, God, is the most respected. Among the wise, You are the Wisest.
Among Names, Your Name, O Lord is the most sublime and among divines You are the great Divine.
VLHE: Jugatan mahi = among those with a good way of life.
Among ways, Yours, God, is the Best Way. Among purifying baths, Yours is the Most Purifying. ||6||
Of the ways Your way is the best, O Lord and of the bathers. You are the best Bather.
695Q: Sidhan mahi = among those with miraculous powers. Sidha = miraculous power. Karman siri = supreme among those who perform deeds.
Among spiritual powers, Yours, O God, are the Spiritual Powers. Among actions, Yours are the Greatest Actions.
Among miracles Yours, O Lord is the best miracle and among deeds Yours deed is the noblest.
supreme among those who perform deeds
JGJF: Agia = command. Hukman siri = supreme among those who command.
Among wills, Your Will, God, is the Supreme Will. Of commands, Yours is the Supreme Command. ||7||
In all the wills, Your will, O Lord, is the supreme and in commands Yours is the over-riding command.

5LLA: As You cause me to speak, so do I speak, O Lord Master. What other power do I have?
